remarks: Recently renovated one bedroom deluxe, Type F layout, at the premier Tamarack Club. Ownership gives you 10-11 rotating weeks per year, giving you all holiday and festival weeks in a 5-6 year rotation. Ownership amenities include discounts on skiing, golfing, year 'round access to the heated indoor/outdoor pool, 2 hot tubs, sauna, fitness center, private owner locker rooms, private owner's lounge, underground parking while lodging overnight, and valet access when coming just for the day.
